title: Cats: The Jellicle Ball on Broadway #catsthejellicleball #catsbroadwa...
transcript: Cats is back on Broadway, now through the lens of Ballroom culture in one of the most brilliant revivals I've ever seen. For a show that's been around for a while and has become both iconic and infamous over the years, reinventing it in 2026 is a huge undertaking. It centers around the enigmatic pack of Jellicle cats convening for an annual ritual where one honored cat is chosen to ascend into a new life. In this version, the Jellicles are a chosen family of queer people who are joyously throwing a ball and using the songs to correspond to various runway categories. Gone are the spandex bodysuits and face paint, in are the fiercest and most opulent costumes you've ever seen. The style of choreography here is pulled straight from Ballroom culture and there are other creative choices that are equally surprising and genius — updated orchestrations, new meanings behind certain plot points, and even some nods to the history of Ballroom. It all comes together in a way that is just as exciting as it is layered and creatively inspired. If you have any familiarity with the musical or Ballroom culture, you'll be better equipped to understand just how dramaturgically brilliant this production is. But even without any context, it is a blast. The cast is incredible, drawing big players from the Ballroom scene and Broadway in a spectacular mix. Every performer is firing on all cylinders, delivering 10s across the board. Even if you're certain that Cats isn't for you, you are wrong. I would consider this an unmissable production, quite possibly the theatrical event of the season. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
